scope: Fishing guide and outfitter licenses, the November 4, 2026 public list, Kentucky Lake and Lake Barkley landings, and four bookable observations. Personal-name domains and candidate names are omitted.

sources.publisher: Kentucky Department of Fish and Wildlife Resources
sources.field_scope: Person licenses. Fishing guide, resident $105.70 and nonresident $422.80, expires the last day of February. Fishing outfitter Tier I, zero guides, resident $264.25 and nonresident $1,057.00. Tier II, one or more guides, resident $792.75 and nonresident $1,585.50. Hunting products are separate. Boater education, a criminal-records check, and CPR and first aid are required. A USCG six-pack may substitute when guiding on a USCG-regulated waterway. Processing is 3 to 4 weeks. No in-person submissions. Online applications use the permit portal.
sources.bulk: The page links a PDF list. It is not itself the row file.
sources.attribution: Cite KDFWR and the page URL. Sale of collected information is prohibited.
sources.request_process: Application through the permit portal or by mail to Law Enforcement in Frankfort. No one was contacted.

sources.field_scope: 301 KAR 3:150. Effective November 6, 2025. Filed October 14, 2025. Page generated August 28, 2026. License year March 1 through the last day of February. Fishing outfitter Tier 1 has no guides. Tier 2 has one or more. A guide license exists only under a listed outfitter. A helper is a person, not a hull. Reports go to the activity portal by the 15th for the previous month and include waterbody per day. Those reports were not downloaded. Footer reserves all rights, 2024.
sources.request_process: The compilation is public. No one was contacted.

sources.field_scope: Resident inspection under KRS 61.872(2). Commercial purpose under KRS 61.870(4) includes sale, resale, solicitation, rent, or expected profit. KRS 61.874(4)(b) requires a certified statement. News and litigation uses are carved out. A directory was not authorized.
